title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FillLevelTargetProfileElement
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FillLevelTargetProfileElement. A description of the various Elements detailing the Fill Level Target Profile consists. Subclass of Thing (http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Thing, not itself translated in this candidate).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'FillLevelTargetProfileElement'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasFillLevelRange.description: Relationship. The range of the fill level for which this FRBC.OperationModeElement applies. If this concept is applied on a Storage it indicated the range in which a storage should remain. Relationship to NumberRange.
